ns2:course.label: Biol Control of Insect Pests
ns2:course.description: Examines the use of biological methods for the control of insect pests; emphasizes the use of natural enemies in control programs; and discusses life history characteristics of parasitoids and predators, ecological principles of population regulation, techniques and protocols in implementation of control programs and related topics. Offered in alternate years. Same as CPSC 477. Prerequisite: IB 444 or IB 482; or consent of instructor.
